g.title: j3777421692
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonAvailable is now true.

g.title: j1402799028
g.text: Check boolean DrifterFaithSol

g.title: j482147963
g.text: Ma famille à Sol ! My family in Sol, how are we this day ?

g.title: j1402799028->j482147963
g.text: true

g.title: j296187124
g.text: Bonjour ! How are we this day?

g.title: j1402799028->j296187124
g.text: false

g.title: j2786372424
g.text: I'm good, how're you?

g.title: j4221945078
g.text: I've been better, but thank you for asking. How're you?

g.title: j2483766595
g.text: I... should confess now that I was lying, I'm not... really a follower of Sol.

g.title: j122189909
g.text: Better now that I'm speaking to you. But you make all my days brighter by being in them.

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j2529855054
g.text: I am doing all right, I suppose. Though as I reflect upon it, I feel as I should not be.

g.title: j433385144
g.text: I am all right, but now you have me curious. Qu'y a-t-il ?

g.title: j3648274928
g.text: Oh ! I... see. Pourquoi ?

g.title: j1972416422
g.text: Wolf ! You will make me fall out of my chair !

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j146917995
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j3756209066
g.text: I was in your shoes, once.

g.title: j2214483392
g.text: It's... just... hard to explain.

g.title: j9781630
g.text: Too much to worry about. Too little time.

g.title: j4012440894
g.text: A friend of mine once described it as "spiders." They creep in now and again.

g.title: j786764497
g.text: Sometimes, everything... just gets to me. But I'll be okay.

g.title: j2047309437
g.text: I thought it would be an opportunity to get to know you better...

g.title: j3815526181
g.text: I thought it would be funny?

g.title: j640175704
g.text: I honestly don't know. It was just impulsive.

g.title: j3072724993
g.text: I do mean it. I'm sorry if I'm making you uncomfortable.

g.title: j1713717988
g.text: I'm sorry. I was just teasing.

g.title: j2711904781
g.text: I am une Sœur de Sol. I am not meant to be... fighting. Killing. The Murmure are not alive, or so the Cavia tell me - but what of the others that I face ?

g.title: j562996303
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j39628008
g.text: Then I shall not pry. I know it is hard to put things into words, sometimes.

g.title: j1970605438
g.text: There was a Sister at the Cathédrale much like this. She would fuss and fuss and fuss. I found her once polishing silver at three in the morning.

g.title: j1041521488
g.text: Ah, oui. I think I know of what you speak. A kind of... cloud, that moves over the sun.

g.title: j1115292395
g.text: Like a cup that fills with water, one drop at a time, non ?

g.title: j2561172348
g.text: You did not need to tell me such a mensonge to know me.

g.title: j592449839
g.text: Je ne comprends pas votre humour. Perhaps in the future, "funny" is different ?

g.title: j3887573712
g.text: I do not know what instinct drove you to tell me such a mensonge.

g.title: j3551776083
g.text: Bon, où en étais-je ?

g.title: j2614771917
g.text: To fight in the name of Sol... is this to be my way ? Am I to be a killer in his name ? Moi, petite Marie ?

g.title: j615802367
g.text: I know you are using une métaphore, but I am howling in laughter ! I do not think you could be in my shoes now if you tried !

g.title: j948891347
g.text: There are so many ways our days and our minds can go awry. It can find dark holes for us to become mired in, non ?

g.title: j578401278
g.text: I asked her why she was doing it, and she said she could not sleep, for she fretted too much.

g.title: j1458647623
g.text: We have a word for this, ennui. A weariness and a discontent that makes all seem... pointless.

g.title: j2840376310
g.text: It will become full and spill. Perhaps even tip its contents. And it all seems like une catastrophe.

g.title: j2201381261
g.text: A soul is more than the faith they wear. I am une Sœur de Sol, but I would hope you see more than that in me, non ?

g.title: j717676253
g.text: To me, it is not.

g.title: j781501282
g.text: I can only hope it was benign, and not a cruel joke at my expense. So, I shall choose to follow in the example of Sol -

g.title: j651754816
g.text: I wasn't trained to be a soldier. Not like the kid. Neither were you.

g.title: j1673278956
g.text: I wasn't... always like this. Always a fighter. I had to learn the hard way.

g.title: j3253331821
g.text: The image of it that is in my head will give me the fits. Before I cannot breathe, tell me - what are you referencing ?

g.title: j106704944
g.text: We can only strive to be kind and patient with ourselves when it does.

g.title: j1585355654
g.text: Each time I would find her in such a way, I would ask if she wanted companie. Sometimes she said yes, sometimes she said no.

g.title: j3917133040
g.text: Or perhaps yours is a desire to hide, to weep, it is more like despair, I cannot say.

g.title: j3053296773
g.text: You clean the mess, you right the cup... and it starts over again, oui ?

g.title: j742820104
g.text: There are as many topics that we could choose as there are stars in the sky !

g.title: j1097657522
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithSol is now false.

g.title: j3778118239
g.text: - whose faith I follow, whether or not you do, and forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.

g.title: j1760688807
g.text: Oui ! The minuscule copie and their triste story... it makes me want to weep to think of it. To be turned into a machine of war by those they thought were famille ?

g.title: j2540128634
g.text: Oui ! So I have heard, you suffered much to learn to fight as you do now. Death is a cruel tutor, I cannot imagine...

g.title: j1077914128
g.text: I do not know if these words will matter to you. Or if they are only so many glowing dots upon a whirring piece of machinerie.

g.title: j3707329791
g.text: I do not know this friend of yours, but I think - how good it is that they have you.

g.title: j1652586943
g.text: There was a Father at the Chapel with a temperament much like yours, I think. He could withstand it all - until he could not.

g.title: j3294552017
g.text: I'm sorry. It was a silly thing to do.

g.title: j1803686669
g.text: Do you forgive me, then?

g.title: j1508231473
g.text: Boolean MarieNoDate is now true.

g.title: j1330731134
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithSol is now false.

g.title: j2849915630
g.text: Non. I would rather be as I am now. I chose to take le Cardinal's hand, the sérum he offered.

g.title: j20093785
g.text: Indeed, when you consider the reality of the thing, when I write these words, it could very well be days or many years since I have set them down, depending on when you are.

g.title: j2574293131
g.text: When he became overwhelmed, and it all seemed a mess, I would ask if he wanted my companie. Des fois, oui, des fois, non.

g.title: j2578063972
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithSol is now false.

g.title: j712591966
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithSol is now false.

g.title: j1507400574
g.text: We are all just blind things, trying to find our way through this world.

g.title: j1367871840
g.text: But you know the sadness that plagues me, the uncertainty. To not be born, or raised, into this life of war.

g.title: j3218047206
g.text: All that is to say, I understand it may feel hollow when I write that you are not alone.

g.title: j4130942570
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2911305060
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1056251706
g.text: But I asked how you were. And the question still stands, petit mensonge ou non.

g.title: j4203040956
g.text: Sometimes, I think about how much I had to discover on my own, and I get a little envious of the kid for the real training they had.

g.title: j3168671903
g.text: I think there's no "good" way to wind up in a life of war. To be born, or raised, or to choose it. In the end, it's about who you are and what you do with it.

g.title: j3139417182
g.text: Though those around you may seem distant or digital or sitting patiently for you to say hello.

g.title: j4087628303
g.text: Oui, and if you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment ! But you are not. And you are forgiven.

g.title: j1449406256
g.text: Oui, I forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.

g.title: j2745611505
g.text: I've... been better, honestly.

g.title: j1787424872
g.text: I'm all right, honestly. How are you, though?

g.title: j2946283783
g.text: Better, now. Thank you. I hear confession is good for people, right?

g.title: j825692538
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j25372706
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j3709667072
g.text: And that I hope this moment passes for you quickly.

g.title: j3573626320
g.text: Qu'y a-t-il ? What is the matter ?

g.title: j47348439
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4033452044
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j659370001
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j464558192
g.text: And if it does not ? I have a solution that always helps !

g.title: j2933959161
g.text: Hah ! Oui, so it is. Très bien, I am glad to hear it.

g.title: j1857431835
g.text: Oui, but then you would not be the rakish wolf we know and love, would you ? I think Sol put you right where you needed to be.

g.title: j4048639760
g.text: Oui, I agree completely. No one is born for war. Well, save these "Grin-ire" I am told of, and even then...

g.title: j2741842295
g.text: Des pâtisseries !

g.title: j99174393
g.text: Ah ! Luncheon is served. I must go. Until later, wolf. I am very glad we spoke.

g.title: j556299896
g.text: But I know what you mean. You see the structure and guidance your other was given, and you cannot help but wish you had the same. Especially when you were so very alone.

g.title: j1486205045
g.text: I wonder if they would not pick another road if given a real choice to do so ?

g.title: j4132951681
g.text: Check boolean MarieRoathePastry1

g.title: j3338332307
g.text: I cannot help but see, now, a minuscule copie who is so very alone... and a wolf who runs with a pack.

g.title: j3540531985
g.text: It's hard, when you're raised to think that's your only purpose, your only existence, to break out of that mold. Purpose gives people comfort.

g.title: j3572628744
g.text: I think they would. There's a few of them who I've met who have proven to me that there's more to the Grineer than just war and death.

g.title: j715592022
g.text: I'll just have to make sure to bring enough pastries for everyone.

g.title: j4132951681->j715592022
g.text: true

g.title: j3256549790
g.text: Thanks, Marie.

g.title: j4132951681->j3256549790
g.text: true

g.title: j4132951681->j3256549790
g.text: false

g.title: j3330436765
g.text: I just won't let Roathe anywhere near them.

g.title: j4132951681->j3330436765
g.text: true

g.title: j38738348
g.text: You can never go wrong with pastries.

g.title: j4132951681->j38738348
g.text: false

g.title: j3772798781
g.text: I think perhaps the tables have turned, non ?

g.title: j3749049472
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j4218406709
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j677097197
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2443816940
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4091651196
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1330536426
g.text: Just do not let the devil near them. Sinon, il va les voler ! He is wont to steal sweets when he is not given his fill !

g.title: j2306872252
g.text: They're still healing. Their journey isn't ended yet.

g.title: j1820271993
g.text: I wish there was more I could do for them.

g.title: j959668509
g.text: Oui, you are correct. So many seek the faith in hopes it will give them just that - purpose. A direction.

g.title: j2069524474
g.text: (So that is how it is spelled, merci !) That gives me such happiness to know. That even a race that was taught that is their only purpose, can find another.

g.title: j907210206
g.text: Now that is the spirit ! Even a devil deserves a bit of pastry now and then, I suppose.

g.title: j436366433
g.text: Je vous en prie. I do hope I have cheered you, even a little. I know you have cheered me.

g.title: j4050935304
g.text: Ah, I complain, but even the lowest devil deserves a bit of pastry now and then, oui ?

g.title: j420323306
g.text: Boolean MarieRoathePastry1 is now true.

g.title: j1565233031
g.text: And you are doing as much as you can, I think. They will come to you when you are needed.

g.title: j3313607559
g.text: So many find a road to travel in hopes it lead them to answers.

g.title: j4287563221
g.text: Boolean MarieGrineer is now true.

g.title: j2461342679
g.text: Well ! Luncheon is served, and now I am hungry. I do hope I have cheered you, even a little. I know you have cheered me.

g.title: j1431599155
g.text: I'll make sure to bring enough for everyone.

g.title: j1833292019
g.text: That is a phenomenal mental image.

g.title: j1505328575
g.text: And why do you travel down a road?

g.title: j2576932697
g.text: Why else would you travel down a road?

g.title: j1316654814
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4074204765
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2565973154
g.text: I think when you find that answer, you discover your own peace.

g.title: j1567635756
g.text: Oui ! Imaginez Lyon and I, when the devil would stroll in, mask and coat over himself, pockets stuffed with stolen sweets !

g.title: j1415035495
g.text: To enjoy the scenery, of course.

g.title: j314433517
g.text: Ah ! Luncheon is served. I must go.

g.title: j590762419
g.text: He would tell us that since the Orokin would rule the system soon, it was not truly theft ! Et puis on se crie dessus et Lyon would beg for silence.

g.title: j2258081537
g.text: Did Roathe bring enough to share, though?

g.title: j2512966628
g.text: And the pastries?

g.title: j2424247533
g.text: Oui, he did. But I do not know if it was by design, or threat of violence from Lyon that inspired it.

g.title: j1449867744
g.text: We could not let it go to waste, n'est-ce pas ?
